# Wardogs: Experience Configs (rule variants, match-state ini, example server)

*Source: `Config/Experiences/` (34 JSON files), `DefaultMatchState.ini` and `ServerConfigs/ExampleStandaloneServerConfig.ini`. The tables are generated by `_tools/experience_config_tables.py` (`--check` to verify). The example server file also holds an admin password field and a banner URL; neither is copied here. The cooked experience packs themselves are in [Experiences (feature)](Wardogs_GameFeatures_Experiences_v2.md); the config values that override native defaults are in the Default Game ini data (`assets/data/default-game-ini.json`).*

An **experience** is a small config file that names a mode: which game feature packs it turns on, which rule flags it sets, which data layers (map content) it loads. `Includes` stacks one definition on another, so `Bakurani_KOTH_01` is `KOTH` plus the Bakurani map layers.

| Without `EditorVisible` | 11 |

| With rule flags (`FeatureFlags`) | 6 |

## 3. Hardcore and Infantry Only

These two are the KOTH variants that the server browser tags as **Hardcore** and **Infantry Only** (see the tag rows in [Frontend data tables](../content/Wardogs_DataTables_Frontend_v1.md) and [Tag Display Text](../content/Wardogs_TagDisplayText_v1.md)).

**Hardcore** (`KOTH_Hardcore`, alias `Hardcore`) turns off these parts of the screen and feedback:

- Rule flags set: `NoDynamicCrosshair`, `KillfeedSquadOnly`, `NoHudAmmo`, `NoMinimapHealth`, `NoQuickSlots` and `Hardcore`.
- Game feature packs disabled: `AlternativeCriticalCamera` and `PlayerHealthBar`.
- Feature flag disallowed: `Vehicle.Feature.ThirdPersonCamera`.
- The file has no `Includes` line, so it is a rule layer meant to sit on top of a KOTH definition; how the layer is attached is not in the file.

**Infantry Only** (`KOTH_InfantryOnly`, alias `InfantryOnly`) includes `KOTH`, sets the rule flag `InfantryOnly` and disables 13 vehicle and emplacement packs:

<!-- experience_config_tables infantry -->
| Disabled feature pack | Vehicle or emplacement it holds |
|---|---|
| `TNK_01` | Heavy, artillery and anti-air tank bodies (L2A6, SPH-2, Flakpanzer Gepard) |
| `ROT_02` | Havoc attack helicopter |
| `ROT_03_WeaponVariants` | Armed AH-6 variants (AH-6M [Miniguns], AH-6R [Rockets]) |
| `WHL_05_Minigun` | Humvee [Minigun] |
| `STN_01` | Talon 9K SAM |
| `STN_02` | Vanguard CIWS |
| `STN_05` | Stingray |
| `TNK_04` | T-72B3 |
| `ROT_04_MachineGun` | Z20 Lakota [Miniguns] |
| `WHL_02_RingTurret` | Kodiak [M249] |
| `WHL_05_RingTurret` | Humvee [M249] |
| `WHL_07_ArmouredBattle` | Ural Defender [M249] |
| `WHL_08_RingTurret` | Wolf-110 [M2 Browning] |
<!-- /experience_config_tables -->

The packs that are not on this list (for example the base Humvee, Kodiak, Ural, Wolf-110, Z20 Lakota and MH-6 packs) stay enabled by this file. What the `InfantryOnly` flag itself does to those is native code and not read from data, so whether unarmed vehicles can still be spawned in this mode is not known from the files.

## 4. Other small definitions

- `ShootingRangeTutorial_Dev` includes `ShootingRangeTutorial` and disables the `DL_Destruction` data layer.
- `Bakurani_SniperShowdown_01`, `Detroit_SniperShowdown_01` and `Moscow_SniperShowdown_01` include `SniperShowdown` and add no layers of their own.
- The **Legacy** and **LegacyAIScenarios** definitions (`ArtWorld`, `KillKennel`, `Lookdev`, `Lookdev_KOTH`, `MapPerf`, `PerformanceCapture`, `HunterKiller`, `ScenarioExample`, `StrikeDisarm`, `VIPEscort`) enable `WDCore` or scenario packs with the core player pawn data. They look like older test and prototype entries (no `EditorVisible` flag); the PvE packs are described in [PvE](Wardogs_GameFeatures_PvE_v2.md).

## 5. Legacy match-state ini

`DefaultMatchState.ini` names three match-state classes that are not in the current SDK; the states in use are the `MatchState.*` sections of the Default Game ini data (post-match 45 s there against 35 s here). The numbers are real file content, but their consumer is not shown, so treat them as legacy.

<!-- experience_config_tables matchstate -->
| Section | Key | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `WDMatchStateWaitingToStart` | `StateTimeLimit` | 5.0 |
| `WDMatchStateWaitingToStart` | `bCanPurchase` | false |
| `WDMatchStateWaitingToStart` | `bCanSpawnVehicles` | false |
| `WDMatchStateWaitingToStart` | `bShouldTrackStats` | false |
| `WDMatchStateWaitingToStart` | `bCanEarnCash` | false |
| `WDMatchStateInProgress` | `StateTimeLimit` | 0 |
| `WDMatchStateEnding` | `StateTimeLimit` | 35.0 |
| `WDMatchStateBase` | `bCanPurchase` | true |
| `WDMatchStateBase` | `bCanSpawnVehicles` | true |
| `WDMatchStateBase` | `bShouldTrackStats` | true |
| `WDMatchStateBase` | `bCanEarnCash` | true |
<!-- /experience_config_tables -->

In words: the waiting state lasts 5 s and blocks purchases, vehicle spawns, stat tracking and cash earning; the in-progress state has no limit; the ending state lasts 35 s; everything else defaults to purchases, vehicle spawns, stats and cash on.
